programs.title: Terminator 3: Rise of the Machines
programs.desc: John Connor, a cybernetic warrior from the future, travels back in time to accomplish his mission of protecting a man and his future wife, Kate, from a robotic attack.

programs.title: Charlie's Angels: Full Throttle
programs.desc: The Angels track down rings containing the names of those in the FBI's witness protection programme. However, the witnesses begin to get murdered one by one.

programs.title: Bloodshot
programs.desc: A soldier who died on duty is resurrected and given superhuman abilities by the RST Corp. But soon he realises the truth about his past and his resurrection and sets out to get revenge.
Micky, a maths professor, enlists five gifted students to use their abilities to win millions at blackjack in Las Vegas. He exploits their talents for personal gain in the glamorous casino city.

programs.title: The Smurfs 2
programs.desc: When Gargamel learns that Smurfette knows a secret spell that can turn Naughties, Smurf-like creatures, into real Smurfs, he kidnaps her. The Smurfs set out to rescue Smurfette.

programs.title: You Don't Mess With the Zohan
programs.desc: Zohan, an Israeli anti-terrorist commando, stages his own death when he gets tired of his job and goes to New York City to follow his dream of being a hairstylist.

programs.title: Hotel Transylvania: Transformania
programs.desc: When Van Helsing's invention goes awry, Johnny turns into a monster and Dracula becomes human. Later, they embark on a journey to find a cure before their transformations become permanent.

programs.title: The Pursuit of Happyness
programs.desc: Tired of Chris's professional failures, his wife decides to separate, leaving him financially broke with an unpaid internship in a brokerage firm and his son's custody to deal with.

programs.title: Don't Breathe
programs.desc: Three delinquents break into the house of Norman, a Gulf War veteran who is visually impaired, to steal his money. However, they discover that Norman is not as helpless as he seems.

programs.title: Bad Boys: Ride or Die
programs.desc: Mike and Marcus face their toughest case yet as their late captain's reputation hangs in the balance. Subsequently, they unravel a complex web of cartel connections in a high-stakes mission.

programs.title: The Unholy
programs.desc: After a girl with hearing impairment envisions the Virgin Mary and regains her ability to hear along with other powers, a journalist unravels the truth behind this paranoia.

programs.title: Ghostbusters: Frozen Empire
programs.desc: The Spengler family must join forces with the original Ghostbusters to stop an ancient evil force from refreezing the world, whilst protecting their iconic New York City firehouse headquarters.

programs.title: Men in Black: International
programs.desc: Agent M, a probationary member of the MIB, teams up with Agent H and uncovers a sinister plot that reveals a traitor in the organisation aiding an alien invasion.

programs.title: Drunken Master
programs.desc: Wong, a mischievous young boy, learns a special form of martial arts from his alcoholic master in order to prevent an assassin from executing his goals.
